profile.headline: Father, Husband and sometimes Software Engineer
profile.summary:
I'm a computing professional focused on developing solutions for interesting problems. I feel motivated by new challenges that need new and innovative solutions that require me to learn new things and gain different experience.
I like working as part of multidisciplinary teams that can provide different points of view. I enjoy leading groups and projects, I'm a people oriented person.

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Borg Control TLM.

Previously Aristotle TL

positions.title: Founder & CTO
positions.description:
On March 2012 we started Kiwox. Our motto as a company is "we want to do things the right way".
We don't consider ourselves a typical company, our most important objectives are to have a great team of motivated and happy people, and to give our customers the best service.
As the CTO I was in charge of the 2 technical areas of the company. The engineering area, that focuses on designing and developing our products, and the operations area, that focuses on keeping our infrastructure and software up and running in the best conditions, and giving support to our customers.

positions.title: Operations Technical Lead & Manager
positions.description:
I'm in charge of keeping all company´s infrastructure and software running.
My team is also responsible of giving support to about 40 different platforms to our customers.

positions.title: Software Architect and Quality Lead
positions.description:
My work involves three main areas.
- Improving the quality of the software the company produces by introducing methodologies for the internal QA area and improving the methodologies used for transference of the finished projects to the support area
- Work on the architectural design of the new projects before the project has been sold to improve the proposals made to the customers
- Look for technologies that can be used in the company and develop and maintain internal standard libraries
I also work as a software engineer leading projects and programming software.

positions.title: University Lecturer
positions.description: I taught "Introduction to Compilers" at the Department of Computer Science.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I worked as part of the innovation team, looking for new technologies and new products for the company.

positions.title: University Lecturer
positions.description: I taught "Introduction to Compilers" at the Department of Computer Science.

positions.title: R&D Engineer
positions.description: R&D Engineer of the Power Compiler product.

positions.title: Development Engineer & Technical Leader
positions.description: Development of Software for Mobile Services Integration. Based mainly in JAVA using REST webservices, but also used PHP and C++.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description: Software Development with C++ and Qt4 for Aeronautical Traffic Control.
